observations: Photo 0 shows a red and black two-seater sofa with a curved backrest and armrests, placed against a dark curtain. A pink pillow and a dark patterned pillow are on the seat.

Photo 1 shows the same sofa from a side angle, with visible silver-colored feet. The red upholstery appears to be vinyl or faux leather, and the black frame is likely plastic or vinyl. The sofa is in a room with tiled flooring and dark curtains.
The sofa has a modern, curved design with visible stitching along the edges. The red seat and backrest are consistent in both photos.
No brand or model is visible on the sofa in either photo.
The seller's text is promotional and does not specify any condition or model.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The sofa may have hidden damage, such as tears, stains, or wear not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the seat, backrest, and armrests showing all sides, including under the cushions and along the seams.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential hidden damage

risks.risk: The upholstery may be low-quality vinyl that peels or tears easily.
risks.proof: A close-up of the red upholstery showing texture and material consistency, especially along the seams and edges.

risks.risk: The sofa may have structural issues, such as loose joints or wobbling legs.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the sofa being gently pushed or shaken to test stability.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the seat, backrest, and armrests showing all sides, including under the cushions and along the seams.
Close-up of the red upholstery to check for material quality and texture.
Photo or video showing the sofa being gently pushed or shaken to test stability.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
